text:
Dani: quick heads-up — q8-slim (new int8 candidate) from last night's bring-up is showing a small but consistent drop on our curated short-instruct promptset. rerank@1 down ~3.7% vs q8-stable.
Marco: yikes. Which slice of the promptset? short-instruct-ops or short-instruct-config?
Dani: Mostly config. I ran the batch eval:
```
./eval_harness --model q8-slim --prompts promptsets/short_config_2026.json --metrics rerank@1,bleurt,bert_score --out artifacts/q8slim_config.json
```
Worst-200 reorder list attached.
Rina: before we spin humans, can we rule out dedupe/paraphrase noise? run the fuzzyhash + semantic cluster pass.
Dani: running: `python tools/semantic_dedupe.py --in artifacts/q8slim_config.json --sim 0.88 --out artifacts/q8slim_dupe_report.json` — will post results shortly.
(20m)
Rina: dup report: 12 exact duplicates, 18 high-similar clusters (>0.9), 25 borderline (0.85-0.9). ~2% exact dup overall. Not enough to explain the pattern.
Marco: ok eligible for micro-golden. Create a focused human review for the top 120 diffs, prioritize examples where gold falls from rank1->rank3. Tag as "q8-slim-config-rerank".
Dani: @label-bot create-batch --name "q8-slim-config-120" --size 120 --golden true --owners Rina,Marco --priority high
label-bot: Batch q8-slim-config-120 created and scheduled. ETA 10-14h. React with :eyes: to allow auto-accept by senior labelers.
Marco: parallel: kick a quant sensitivity sweep toggling kv_cache, prefill and kernel_mode. Command: `./quant_sweep --model q8-slim --vars kv_cache:{on,off},prefill:{0,32},kernel_mode:{fast,precise}`. Save artifacts to /artifacts/q8slim_sweep.
Dani: also create a 1% canary route pinned to q8-slim for the config route only. Want live rerank flips + user-helpful signal.
qa-bot: Canary route created: canary/q8-slim-1pct-config (deploy id 92077). Dashboards updated to include rerank flips, BERTScore drift, and user-helpful events.
Rina: labeling plan: blind pair senior relabel, adjudicate disagreements, plus adversarial paraphrase step (synth paraphrases x3 per example). If micro-golden pass-rate < 0.97 or entailment delta > 0.03 we hold rollout. Decision owners: Marco + Rina.
Marco: add one more check - run a tokenizer-config diff vs q8-stable to ensure no normalization drift (we had whitespace normalizer change once). Dani can you `git diff` the tokenizers?
Dani: ran diff: no tokenizer-config drift. Also ran a short kernel precision compare — fast kernel has slightly higher float variance but not enough to explain semantic shift on its own. Artifacts: /artifacts/q8slim_kernel_compare
Rina: good. Tag promptset examples with metadata: tag=["q8-slim-investigation","config_short_2026"], provenance=eval_run:1783456789, snapshot=snap-1783456789-config
label-bot: Added metadata tags to samplebank entries and linked snapshot snap-1783456789-config.
Marco: if humans find systematic omission of step-level details (like missing filenames/vars), escalate to targeted golden expansion (add 300 more config prompts) and run a prompt engineering rollback test.
Dani: noted. I'll prepare a rapid prompt-template rollback that rephrases prompts to explicit step anchors and run a small A/B against q8-slim in canary if needed.
qa-bot: Scheduled additional metric: pairwise entailment on top-5 outputs per example. Will post to canary dashboard within 2h.
Rina: once label-bot returns results, we'll reconvene. If pass-rate >= 0.98 and entailment delta < 0.02 we can promote; else rollback and pin canary to q8-stable.
Marco: cool. Keep logs/artifacts in the snapshot. Ping #eng-ml if anything breaches thresholds. :eyes:
Dani: thanks — monitoring the label-bot queue and quant-sweep. Will update thread with relabel outcomes and canary links.
